title: BERRY CHERRY POP – VAPEHUB ULTRA 20000
description:
The BERRY CHERRY POP flavour is a delightful explosion of fruity sensations, transporting your taste buds to a summer orchard. Imagine biting into a juicy cherry, its sweetness bursting while a medley of succulent berries dances around your palate.

This vibrant blend combines tart and sweet profiles, featuring luscious notes of strawberries, tangy raspberries, and juicy blueberries, all intertwined with bold cherries. The result is a perfectly balanced concoction, refreshing and indulgent, making it an irresistible choice for fruit lovers.
